Both Cajamarca and Deportivo Moquegua got promoted for the first time in their history. These four teams are set to play two double-legged semi-final matchups, with the winners contesting the finals over two legs. However, the format for this stage considers changes if one or both of the tournament winners place in the top two of the aggregate table.
